property_summary: For every caller address, the reference contract only allows the depositorAccount (the mutable depositorAccount state) to call setL1BlockValues; the mutant that compares against the constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT instead will allow calls from that hard-coded address even when depositorAccount is a different address, breaking the rule for some fuzzed depositorAccount value.
change_summary: Replace the require check to compare msg.sender against the public constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT (uppercase) instead of depositorAccount, allowing the known constant address to pass.
